messages:
deploy-bot: :bell: Preflight for release v2026.04.10 -> prod halted: env parity check failed for secret key `TLS_KEYSTORE`. staging != prod. See run: https://ci.internal/runs/10199

ada: Can someone paste the exact diff?

ci-bot: preflight excerpt:
```
staging: TLS_KEYSTORE="sops:ENC[AES256_GCM,data:...,iv:...,tag:...]"
prod: TLS_KEYSTORE=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef12-3456
```

tom: Staging has SOPS-wrapped blobs, prod uses raw KMS ARN pointer. The keystore loader in prod expects a KMS URI and will skip retrieval if it sees SOPS envelope.

sree: Canary run showed TLS handshake failures during startup when the service received the SOPS blob instead of KMS pointer. Crash loop for the TLS init.

ops-oncall: Change window is 90m. If we need a prod fix, infra lead approval required.

ada: Quick options: 1) revert to previous artifact (v2026.04.09) 2) create a compatibility shim init that detects SOPS blob, decrypts via SOPS agent, and writes a KMS-style file 3) normalize secret backend and re-run migration (longer).

tom: Revert is fastest but will also undo a security migration that depends on new artifact. Compatibility shim feels lowest blast radius for canary.

sec-bot: Security constraints: any shim must not expose plaintext in logs, and SOPS decryption must run in a sealed environment. Audit record required for secret access.

sree: I can author a tiny init-sidecar that calls sops to decrypt if payload starts with "sops:" and writes keystore file to /run/secrets/keystore. Adds 2s startup. Can deploy to canary within 25m.

ada: I'll prepare a paramstore alias TLS_KEYSTORE_URI that points to a temporary store location for canary pods, leaving original keys untouched. ops, please confirm audit path.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. Create alias and emit audit event. Approve canary hotpatch pending sec-bot sign-off.

sec-bot: Reviewed init-sidecar plan: ok if container image is from internal registry and runs with no shell access, and we mount no logs. Needs an explicit deny for reading logs.

ci-bot: Note: tests that assert exact secret string will fail unless they prefer TLS_KEYSTORE_URI alias. Update CI accordingly.

sree: Canary up (5% traffic) with init-sidecar + alias. Monitoring 10m smoke now.

tom: Watching metrics. TLS handshakes established. No 5xxs in first 6m.

ada: Alias created and audit logged: https://audit.internal/entry/99921

sree: Canary smoke OK at 10m. No regressions. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Infra eyeballs done. Proceed limited rollout with 30m observation window. Keep rollback ready.

ada: Drafted release note snippet: "Deployment paused due to keystore backend encoding mismatch between staging and prod; temporary compatibility init-sidecar and TLS_KEYSTORE_URI alias created for gradual rollout; follow-up: consolidate secret encoding and remove shim." Link: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.04.10-keystore-compat

deploy-bot: Release v2026.04.10 status: HALTED -> CANARY (init-sidecar) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assignments: sree (sidecar hotpatch), ada (alias + notes), tom (monitor). Action logged.
